title: ULTRAGUNS
body:
![dkakd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ab9191542f4761b2f1b05189cbd22abe8bc640e.png)

This resource pack replaces the crossbow with a revolver and replaces arrows with bullets from **ULTRAKILL**. New versions of **ULTRAKILL** weapons will be released soon.
